source_row.rationale: Cerebral edema, which can develop over the days following a large ischemic stroke, presents with worsening headache, decreasing level of consciousness, and other signs of increased intracranial pressure, requiring close monitoring given the risk of herniation.
source_row.source_name: AHA/ASA — Cerebral Edema Management After Large Stroke
